Riding: point to steer, hold the button to brake, right-click (a two-finger tap) to turn round, scroll or pinch to come nearer or go further off, click to start again; carrying the tommy gun (the skier alone, or the horse's rider), the button fires it at the mark and Shift brakes; or the arrows steer, Shift brakes, X turns round, Enter starts again.
